name: Okunaga Mio
source:
Likes: Her work, her friends, her brother (that's a secret)
Dislikes: Lies

Shun's older sister who works at an eroge company. She is currently looking after her brother because their parents are abroad on a business trip, although most of the time she only supports him financially and lets [url=/c119870]Ayane[/url] handle the rest. Actually good at all sorts of household chores, however Mio doesn't have many chances to show her skills off due to working a lot. She often uses the things that happen in Shun's life as a reference for her games.
